headline: hook
source: Source: Port Authority of NY & NJ, street pricing rules for airport concessions

scenes.text: Everyone says airports can charge whatever they want.
scenes.head: AIRPORT PRICES HAVE A LEGAL LIMIT

scenes.text: In New York? Nope. Put the wallet down.
At JFK, LaGuardia and Newark, shops can't charge more than 15% over regular city prices.
scenes.say: At J F K, LaGuardia and Newark, shops can't charge more than fifteen percent over regular city prices.

scenes.text: A three-dollar water in the city? Three forty-five here, tops.
The twist? The cap used to be 10%. So the limit got a raise. Must be nice.
Worst airport price you ever paid?
